تشتكوا (form VIII)
# تَشْتَكُوا (taštakū) /taʃ.ta.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
# تُشْتَكَوْا (tuštakaw) /tuʃ.ta.kaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
